question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'hearing.'

__*Key Points__

__
 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:

 
 
• **Hearing: **the ability to hear. (सुनने की क्षमता, श्रवण-शक्ति)
 
• **Suffering: **the state of undergoing pain, distress, or hardship. (पीड़ा, कष्‍ट या वेदना)
 
• **Enduring: **lasting over a period of time; durable. (स्‍थायी, टिकाऊ)
 
• **Inspiring: **having the effect of inspiring someone; giving someone positive or creative feelings. (प्रेरक, प्रेरणापूर्ण)
 
 
 
• Here, the sentence refers to losing an ability due to illness.
 
• **Option** 1 is correct in this context.

 

Correct paragraph:__ **Can you __**imagine**__ a deaf woman writing stories about a war? Well, Laura Redden Searing did this. Moreover, she went to foreign countries to write stories. She was very ill when she was 11 years old. Because of this, she lost her __**hearing**__. She went to the Missouri School for the Deaf. Laura was 19 years old when she went to work for a newspaper. She wrote about people, places and art. In 1859, most women were just wives and ______ (3) _______. They did not work outside the home; otherwise, their husbands would be angry. Due to this feeling, Laura used a ______ (4) _______ name when she wrote her stories. She called herself Howard Glyndon. She thought that unless she used a masculine name, people would be ______ (5) _______ since they did not think that women should write for newspapers.*

44:T13a7,

The correct answer is- 'mothe
